Third-party code and fonts bundled with Form Filler (Chrome extensions cannot load remote code).
All copied unmodified from their official sources (source-map comments removed from the JS).

pdf-lib 1.17.1               MIT          https://github.com/Hopding/pdf-lib            (npm tarball)
pdfjs-dist 4.10.38           Apache-2.0   https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js             (npm tarball)
@pdf-lib/fontkit 1.1.1       MIT          https://github.com/Hopding/fontkit            (npm tarball)
regenerator-runtime 0.13.11  MIT          https://github.com/facebook/regenerator       (npm tarball, needed by fontkit's UMD build)
Noto Sans Devanagari Regular SIL OFL 1.1  https://github.com/notofonts/devanagari       (notofonts.github.io, unhinted TTF)
